hooks.command: ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; BIN="$ROOT/bin/module-crew"; if [ -n "$ROOT" ] && [ -x "$BIN" ]; then "$BIN" hook session-start || true; fi; exit 0
ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; BIN="$ROOT/bin/module-crew"; if [ -n "$ROOT" ] && [ -x "$BIN" ]; then "$BIN" hook prompt || true; fi; exit 0
ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; BIN="$ROOT/bin/module-crew"; if [ -n "$ROOT" ] && [ -x "$BIN" ]; then "$BIN" hook session-end || true; fi; exit 0
